Home is stocked with Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar, bottles of water, and a starter amenity package with a roll of paper towels, dish soap, sponge, kitchen wipes, dishwasher soap, laundry detergent pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, bathroom soaps, and a roll of toilet paper in each bathroom.

Discover this charming 30A vacation rental in the highly sought-after Seagrove Beach area, nestled within The Hammocks, an exclusive gated community. Perfect for family vacations or group getaways, this beautifully designed home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests. Just 500 yards from the Gulf of Mexico and minutes from Seaside and Watercolor, the property blends modern comfort with coastal elegance.

This luxury vacation rental is ideally located for exploring the best of 30A. A short golf cart or bike ride brings you to Seaside, where you can enjoy a variety of free events, unique boutiques, and dining options. To the east, Seagrove Beach offers a serene setting with its beautiful oak canopies, magnolia trees, and delightful local restaurants and shops.

The outdoor area of this vacation home is designed for relaxation and enjoyment. Dine al fresco on the paver patio with a propane grill, unwind in one of the Adirondack chairs, or rinse off in the convenient outdoor shower after a day at the beach. The property also includes a 6-seater golf cart for easy access to local attractions and two community pools for added fun and relaxation.

Step onto the inviting front porch, where a cozy daybed swing awaits, and feel your worries melt away. Once inside, you will see that the home perfectly blends coastal charm and modern sophistication. The décor features a soothing palette of greens and blues, echoing the natural beauty of the nearby Gulf waters. Rattan accents throughout the home add a touch of organic texture, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere that feels both timeless and contemporary. From the serene bedrooms to the airy living spaces, every detail evokes a sense of tranquility and effortless coastal style.

The first floor of this two-story gem features a spacious living area, perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach. A modern kitchen awaits you with top-of-the-line appliances, island with bar seating for five, and the adjacent dining area has seating for 8, making it ideal for gathering with family and friends. For convenience, a washer and dryer are located on the first floor, ensuring an easy and comfortable stay.

The primary King suite is on the first floor, providing a tranquil retreat. This space features a plush king-sized bed and an en-suite bathroom with a spacious walk-in shower with modern fixtures, providing a spa-like experience right at home. With stylish barn slider doors adding a touch of rustic charm, the King Suite offers the perfect blend of luxury and tranquility. A Queen guest bedroom with thoughtful touches and a spacious bathroom with a walk-in shower complete the first floor.

Upstairs, you'll find two more inviting bedrooms: another Queen room and a bunk room with two sets of twin-over-twin bunks, perfect for kids or additional guests. The shared upstairs Jack and Jill bathroom features a walk-in shower.

Discover the perfect blend of comfort, style, and location at our 30A vacation rental in Seagrove Beach. Book your stay today and experience the charm of this beautiful home, your ideal destination for a memorable beach getaway.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
